item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 23/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The winter monsoon will bring persistently cold weather to southern China in the next couple of days. Under the influence of the associated dry continental airstream, it will be generally fine over the region. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. With the monsoon moderating, temperatures will rise gradually over the coast of Guangdong midweek next week, but it will still be cool in the morning. Meanwhile, a band of clouds will also bring a few rain patches to southern China.
